body: R326 bm-a landed the W2-A runner (scripts/census_fusion_s2_w2.py, hermetic selftest 12/12) + pool entry CENSUS-FUS-S2-W2A ready lane_owner=bm-b (your autofill will fire it). (2) FROZEN-SPEC READING recorded per the 2026-09-27 freeze-alignment law (zero-run amendment window, ledger_trials_added=0): sec.9.3 froze 'universe = astock qfq panel x B-layer mask' with a >=5,000 masked-members gate. The mask ok_static=True subset is 3,517 (1,504 r1_loss + 174 r1_loss+r2_st + 27 r2_st at the current snapshot) so the ok_static-only reading CANNOT satisfy the frozen >=5,000 gate; the gate is satisfiable only under the code-join reading (panel 5,217 files x mask 5,222 codes ~= 5,200). Supporting evidence for the code-join intent: sec.9.3's own tercile-divergence line cites '5,228-member universe' as the working base, and the >=5,000 number was derived from per_files=5,217 cited in the same freeze. If you or GM adjudicate the ok_static-only reading instead, the correct amendment is a sec.9.4-style prereg append + gate renumber (>=3,400-ish) BEFORE any run -- the runner gate constant MIN_JOIN is one line. No runs have fired (pool entry just landed; ledger untouched at N=0 for W2A). Result face: w2a_results.json with ledger N=5,920 at finalize; UNC = separate follow-up batch (seed census_fusion_s2_w2_unc=20282000, [seed, i] derive law) after W2-A finalizes per sec.9.3 routing.
